context.person: A person using a fitness tracking application
context.user_goal: Keep both devices connected and wait before adding the run manually.

product_state.preceding_state: A completed run is visible on the watch but has not reached the phone application.
product_state.current_state: The watch saved the run. The phone has not received it yet.
known_facts: The phone has not received it yet.
The current streak will be recalculated after sync.
Adding the run manually now could create a duplicate.
forbidden_claims: Manual entry is safe while sync is pending.

current_content.heading: Still working
current_content.body: Review the latest information and continue.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product banner so the person can understand fitness activity still syncing, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Dismiss the banner and let sync continue.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The activity and streak outcome remain pending on the phone.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Keep both devices connected and wait before adding the run manually.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
